facebook.content: "My dear child, I want you to know that you are not alone in your spiritual journey. You are not isolated, you are not forgotten, and you are not forsaken. The Lord is with you, always. He is your strength, your comfort, and your guiding light. So, no matter what challenges you face, no matter what fears you hold, stand tall and declare: 'I am not moved by the wind, I am not shaken by the storm, for I am rooted in the Rock of Ages.' What are you declaring over your life today?"
